name: teamsherrard-agent-attraction
description: Team Sherrard's Agent Attraction OS: plug-and-play AI systems for real estate agents who attract agents to a cloud-brokerage organization, a local team, or a local brokerage.

plugins.name: attraction-ai-brain
plugins.description: PLUGIN 1 — install first. The Agent Attraction Brain: one shared brain (who you are as a leader, your story, what you can teach, who your story speaks to, your numbers, your voice) every other system reads. 'Set up my attraction brain' is four short conversations and three answers in your own voice, one plain question at a time; then every tool knows you and you get your Brain Book. Also the Daily Debrief, Prospect Radar, the Brokerage Model Expert, the Rev Share Calculator and Capture.

plugins.name: maa-claude-support
plugins.description: PLUGIN 2 — install with Plugin 1. MAA Claude Support: the help desk for the Master Agent Attraction cohort. Say "help" for any Claude question, a look-only diagnosis, a setup audit, what week you're in and the catch-up plan, and "what did Mike say about…" answered from the full MAA lesson knowledge base with the lesson to rewatch. Read-only by constitution; routes every fix to the skill that owns it.

plugins.name: attraction-lead-magnet
plugins.description: PLUGIN 3 — install in Week 2. Lead Magnets & Opt-In Funnels pointed at agents, offer-first in one sitting: builds your Partner Offer if it isn't built yet, recommends ONE lead magnet from your unique value proposition and Mike's lessons (say yes, or ask for the next best), writes the magnet and its sales funnel outline, and puts them into your Week 3 Kit — the one file for Claude Design in Week 3. Then delivery, nurture, partners, Google profile, bios, analytics. Requires Plugin 1.

plugins.name: attraction-shortform-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 4 — install in Week 4. The Short-Form Attraction Engine: one sitting confirms your profiles and two keywords, asks one question (your filming day), builds your Game Plan — two Reels you film and one carousel you post every week from week one, about one post in ten asking for the guide — maps your four weeks onto your own Notion board, switches on ONE draft-only Monday Week Plan with your yes, connects Metricool and scripts your first Reel, then stops. Requires Plugins 1 and 3.

plugins.name: realtor-ai-editing-studio
plugins.description: PLUGIN 5 — install in Week 4 with Short-Form. The AI Editing Studio: Claude edits your Reels and long videos in your own Riverside account, or in Instagram's free Edits app on your Mac (your choice) — cuts the fluff, finds the hook, cleans the audio, adds captions, music, B-roll and your Week 3 brand graphics — every change checked, nothing posted without your yes. It never writes titles, captions or descriptions. Requires Plugin 1 and either a Riverside Grow plan or higher, or a Mac with Edits.

plugins.name: attraction-youtube-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 6 — install in Week 5 (date to be confirmed). The Long-Form Authority Engine: one sitting sets up your channel for the agents you want to attract, builds your YouTube Game Plan (one video a week to start), puts your next 30 days on the YouTube tab of your board (publish checklist and a real video to watch first on each card), switches on ONE draft-only workflow with your Yes — your Monday Kickoff, reviewing last month each first Monday — and hands you your first video. Requires Plugin 1.

plugins.name: attraction-conversion-sales
plugins.description: PLUGIN 7 — install in Week 6. Conversion & Sales: one sitting writes your enrollment call script, your partner presentation and your objection playbook in your words, switches on ONE draft-only workflow with your Yes — your Morning Call Prep: every partner call on today’s calendar prepped, Mondays your follow-ups, on the 1st anyone who went quiet — then hands you to Stacy, your sales trainer, in a new chat: she plays the agent, scores you and makes you say it again. Requires Plugin 1.
